// Five mana profiles in twelve cards: the shape that makes a `can_cast` clause
// expensive, small enough to enumerate on the whole palette as well as on the
// colours one cost demands. Two of the five make blue; three do not, and no
// question about {U} can tell those three apart.
1x Island [Land]
1x Hallowed Fountain [Land]
1x Tranquil Cove [Land]
1x Forest [Land]
1x Mountain [Land]
1x Jungle Hollow [Land]
6x Lightning Bolt [Burn]
